codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

items.question: What is Anvil Quest?
items.answer: Anvil Quest is a fantasy RPG on Roblox where you play as a blacksmith apprentice forging weapons and battling bosses across the Shattered Isles. It launched in January 2026 and has over 12 million visits.

items.question: Which class should beginners pick in Anvil Quest?
items.answer: Warrior is the most beginner-friendly class thanks to high HP and simple mechanics. Once you understand the game, Rogue offers the highest damage output for experienced players.

items.question: How do I redeem codes in Anvil Quest?
items.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the 'Redeem Code' field, and hit confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

items.question: Is Anvil Quest free to play?
items.answer: Yes, Anvil Quest is completely free on Roblox. There are optional cosmetic microtransactions, but they do not affect gameplay balance.

items.question: How often does Anvil Quest update?
items.answer: Forge Studios releases major content updates roughly every two weeks, with smaller hotfixes in between. New bosses and codes are typically added with each major patch.
